title: The Invasion: WWF vs. The Alliance
summary: WCW and ECW identities become an invading force within WWF television. This is the WWF-produced 2001 angle, not WCW’s own historical storyline archive.

chapters.title: WCW and ECW unite
chapters.result: The invading factions form The Alliance.
chapters.context: The opposition is reorganized as a combined threat.

chapters.title: Austin defects to The Alliance
chapters.result: The Alliance wins the main event after Austin turns against Team WWF.
chapters.context: The WWF champion joins the invading side.

chapters.title: Winner takes all
chapters.result: Team WWF defeats The Alliance in the elimination main event.
chapters.context: The final match ends The Alliance’s on-screen bid for control.
